notes: Entries are median [IQR], where IQR = Q3 - Q1, across eight checkpoint inputs per dataset (two training paths x logged rounds 0, 9, 49, 100). Each input's time is the median of 20 warm repetitions after five warmups. CPU, FP32, one PyTorch thread. Memory is cold-pass peak incremental CPU RSS above the resident-input baseline, sampled every 1 ms; it is not GPU memory. Positive IQRs that round to 0.00 are shown as <0.01. Server step includes aggregation and all requested broadcasts. File I/O, serialization, device transfers, model loading and evaluation are excluded. Dense SVD constructs the dense matrix, uses economy full SVD, then truncates; it is not an optimized truncated-SVD solver.
